meta.note: De-identified published CBC and chemistry for Inspiration4 crew C001–C004. Not the simulated AEGIS crew, and not an input to the live check-in scorer. Not medical advice. n = 4. Pre-flight and post-flight draws only; no in-flight sample. Baselines use 2 or 3 pre-flight draws.
meta.day_meaning: L timepoints are days before launch and are stored negative. R timepoints are days after return and are stored positive. The mission sits between L-3 and R+1. This file has no in-flight sample, so day is not one continuous mission clock.
meta.baseline_rule: Mean of the available L timepoints for that person and analyte. C003 CBC uses L-44 and L-3 only.
meta.far_rule: far_from_baseline is true only for a post-flight value that is inside the lab range printed on that draw, is not an R+45 sample-handling artefact, and has |z| >= 2 with z = (value - pre-flight mean) / pre-flight sample sd. The sd uses n - 1 and has no floor. far_from_baseline is null for pre-flight draws, excluded rows, and artefacts.
meta.artefact_rule: At R+45 only: glucose under 50 mg/dL, or potassium over 5.5 mmol/L. Treated as sample handling, not biology. Percent change is still reported.

analytes.label: Hemoglobin
analytes.unit_note: The source column is named hemoglobin_value_percent. The numbers and the printed interval match g/dL, not percent. Hematocrit is the percent column and is not used here.

synthetic_day_to_day_sd.note: Stated and realized day-to-day sds from ml/results/synthetic_crew.md. Inspiration4 sds are weeks-apart pre-flight draws, not day-to-day.
